text.en: RepLKNet is row 4 of the BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual table in the Vision area.
text.zh: RepLKNet 是 BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）年度表第 4 行，所属领域为“视觉”。

text.en: The annual table associates RepLKNet with “Scaling Up Your Kernels to 31x31: Revisiting Large Kernel Design in CNNs”.
text.zh: 年度表把 RepLKNet 与论文《Scaling Up Your Kernels to 31x31: Revisiting Large Kernel Design in CNNs》关联。

text.en: The Main Contributors field is “Xiaohan Ding,Xiangyu Zhang”.
text.zh: “主要人物”字段依次列出 丁霄汉、张祥雨；官方英文原文为“Xiaohan Ding,Xiangyu Zhang”。

text.en: Xiaohan Ding and Xiangyu Zhang, the two contributors named by BenchCouncil, are the first two authors of the CVPR paper; the arXiv record additionally lists Yizhuang Zhou, Jungong Han, Guiguang Ding and Jian Sun.
text.zh: BenchCouncil 列出的丁霄汉和张祥雨是 CVPR 论文前两位作者；arXiv 完整作者表还包括周逸庄、Jungong Han、丁贵广和孙剑。

text.en: RepLKNet is a pure CNN built with re-parameterized large depth-wise convolutions whose kernel size reaches 31x31, contrasting with the commonly used 3x3 design.
text.zh: RepLKNet 是采用重参数化大核深度卷积的纯 CNN，卷积核最大达到 31×31，与常用的 3×3 设计形成对照。

text.en: The paper reports 87.8% ImageNet top-1 accuracy and 56.0% mIoU on ADE20K, and analyzes large-kernel CNNs as having larger effective receptive fields and stronger shape bias than small-kernel CNNs.
text.zh: 论文报告 87.8% 的 ImageNet top-1 准确率和 56.0% 的 ADE20K mIoU，并分析指出大核 CNN 比小核 CNN 具有更大的有效感受野和更强的形状偏置。
